title: Lab - Environment profiles and template user environments
description: Give every user, present and future, the same defaults.
scenario: Give every user, present and future, the same defaults. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Profile
tasks.instructions: Export EDITOR=vim for all users via /etc/profile.d.

tasks.title: Task 2 - skel
tasks.instructions: Add a README to /etc/skel and create a new user to prove it arrives.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Alias
tasks.instructions: Give user ana a personal alias ll='ls -la' that survives logout.
